frontier.hypothesis: Residual A (2 insns) is a dz/dx seat assignment: f1/f3 already give the target's emission order for the whole test-3 block, and the only remaining error is dz in $v1 / dx in $a0 where the target has dz in $a0 / dx in $v1. The permuter did not touch it in 55k iterations.
frontier.mechanism: local-alloc quantity numbering follows the post-sched1 insn order, so the declaration order that fixes the emission order also flips the two seats; this is global.c/local-alloc, not sched.c.
frontier.next_probe: tools/ra_solver/inverse_compose.py classify on the dz and dx seats against the f1 body (memory/grind/func_8002D780/rejected/relvec-dx-before-az-order-right-regs-swapped-14.c) — it returns REACHABLE/FORECLOSED plus a ranked C-lever vector. Do NOT re-sweep declaration orders; twelve are measured in s3 and the two that hold the floor are the two in candidate.c. This is the solver modality's job and it is now the highest-value untried axis.

frontier.hypothesis: Residual B (5 insns) is the second pseudo holding dist in $a0 (move a0,s1 in the beqz delay slot) feeding the LZCS island input and the srlv, while $s1 keeps the compare, the small-path LUT index and the call arguments. Twenty-three source spellings of the copy are now dead, including the permuter's own embedded-assignment form.
frontier.mechanism: cse.c make_regs_eqv folds every single-def copy into its source pseudo, so no natural C copy survives to reload; the target compile kept two pseudos. Because build_insns never moves off 202 for any of the twenty-three spellings, the copy is being eliminated in cse and not merely coalesced later.
frontier.next_probe: tools/ra_solver inverse_compose.py classify on the $a0 seat, and read tmp/grind/func_8002D780/dumps/code6cac_b.cse / .combine to confirm the fold point rather than re-deriving it. Only if that returns FORECLOSED for every natural form does the sibling func_8002D518's FAKE dead-store re-store (src/code6cac_b.c:1244-1265, .claude/rules/dead-store-fake-exception.md) become the sanctioned last resort, and it would cite a twenty-three-spelling exhaustion ledger.

frontier.hypothesis: candidate.c's six fresh once-written test-3 locals (ax/az/bx/bz/dx/dz) need a family decision BEFORE any candidate-ready submission, because review verdicts are keyed by body and respelling after a layer-1 verdict is not available.
frontier.mechanism: The family-selection table routes a fresh once-written once-read local carrying a real consumed value to the named-intermediate family (six prongs, FAKE required); the competing reading is that vertex-0-relative vectors are ordinary geometric C needing no family claim.
frontier.next_probe: grep docs/reference/sotn-construct-index.md for vertex-relative / difference-local precedent, then either write the six-prong named-intermediate self-vet or emit a ruling-request naming both readings — decide before the body is submitted.
